_comment: Word ceilings for the standing docs, enforced by scripts/verify-doc-budgets.py.
A ceiling is a ratchet, not a reduction target. The relocate -> condense -> raise
order lives in AGENTS.md section 'Documentation budgets'. There is deliberately
no target word count there — what belongs in a doc is decided by a question, not a number.
docs/decisions/ is deliberately unbudgeted: it is where the stories go, and
budgeting it would push them back into AGENTS.md, which is the thing being fixed.
CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md and is budgeted once, under the real file.
The four over-target docs are frozen at what they measure; the rest carry 5% headroom.
